_comment: Hardcoded item→buff links not derivable from Objects.json Buffs arrays. Add entries when the game applies a buff via C# logic rather than the data-driven Buffs[] field.

mechanisms.buff-full: Granted when the player eats any food item.
mechanisms.buff-quenched: Granted when the player drinks any drink item.
mechanisms.buff-warrior-energy: Granted by the Warrior enchantment on a sword (proc on kill).
mechanisms.buff-adrenaline-rush: Granted by the Haymaker enchantment on a sword or scythe.
mechanisms.buff-yoba-s-blessing: Granted by the Blessed enchantment on boots (proc on near-death).
